learnings: API failures (HTTP 400) should trigger automatic retry or fallback to a different model rather than marking files as inconclusive
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty' in the verdict logic

Model selection should consider reliability - a model that fails on 30% of critical files provides less value than one that completes the full audit
